title: 第9章 劳务派遣中心第10章 思念之墙
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 就这样，希娅暂时加入了林鬼的行程。
有这位超凡精灵游侠同行，穿越危机四伏的奥多峡谷，变得出乎意料的顺利。
林鬼紧握着缰绳，感受着身下巨蜥稳健的步伐。
同时也不忘借此机会，见识希娅的真正实力。
尤其是她那堪称恐怖的视力。
当希娅突然抬手示意停止，指着远处一片看似平静的山坡。
清晰地说出四公里外，三只潜伏的石化蜥蜴的具体位置时，林鬼不禁暗自咋舌。
在毫无遮挡的情况下，她的视线竟能穿透如此遥远的距离。
这简直是天生的顶级斥候。
在希娅精准的指引下，林鬼驾驭着巨蜥，沿着七拐八绕的隐蔽路径前进。
她时而侧耳倾听风声，时而眯起血眸远眺。
总能提前数十个呼吸发现潜在威胁。
他们巧妙地利用地形掩护，竟然完美避开了所有恶魔的活动区域。
奥多峡谷相对开阔的视野，让希娅的远视能力得到了淋漓尽致的发挥。
仅仅半天后，就抵达了他们的目的地——卡兰城。
庞大的城池巧妙地依偎在连绵的山丘之间。
高耸的城墙在阳光下泛着冷硬的光泽。
宛如一头蛰伏的巨兽，随时可能苏醒。
出示了冒险者铭牌，卫兵粗略地检查了背包里那显眼的、塞满的信封，没有过多阻拦。
林鬼跟随着川流不息的人潮。
穿过了高度超过五十米、由黢黑黑曜石的巨型岩石砌成的宏伟城墙。
正式进入了这座真正的城邦。
一进城，希娅便率先转过身。
城门洞内的阴凉，与城内投射下的第一束温暖阳光。
在她身上交织，勾勒出她纤细的身形。
她对着林鬼展颜一笑，血玉般的眼眸，在光线下，显得格外清澈。
“第一次来卡兰城，感觉怎么样？“
穿过最后一个关卡，林鬼环顾四周，目光敏锐地扫过每一个细节。
除了规模比新约城大了数倍之外，似乎并无太多本质区别。
一条宽阔的主干道，由巨大的石板铺就。
笔直地延伸向远方山丘上，领主的城堡。
主干道两旁，是无数狭窄、坑洼不平的泥泞小道。
像血管般延伸至城市的各个角落。
小道边，挤满了乱搭乱建的石头或木头房子。
它们紧密地挨在一起，显得阴暗而潮湿。
耳边是各种声音混杂的轰鸣。
商贩声嘶力竭的叫卖、车轮碾过石板的隆隆巨响。
佣兵粗鲁的笑骂、魔兽坐骑不耐烦的嘶鸣。
以及远处铁匠铺传来的、永不停歇的叮叮当当的打铁声......
所有这些声音交织，构成一曲混乱的城市交响乐。
神情麻木的平民背着沉重的货物，驼着背。
眼神躲闪地为巡逻的卫兵让路。
风尘仆仆的冒险者公然搂着衣着暴露、眼神空洞的流莺。
肆无忌惮地调笑着。
content_en:
In this way, Shia temporarily joined the Lin Kuei's itinerary.
With this extraordinary elf ranger as his companion, crossing the dangerous Odo Canyon became unexpectedly smooth.
Lin Gui held the reins tightly, feeling the steady pace of the giant lizard beneath him.
At the same time, he did not forget to take this opportunity to see Xia’s true strength.
Especially her terrifying eyesight.
When Xia suddenly raised her hand to signal to stop, pointing to a seemingly calm hillside in the distance.
When he clearly stated the specific location of the three lurking basilisks four kilometers away, Lin Gui couldn't help but secretly marveled.
Without any obstruction, her sight could penetrate such a long distance.
This is simply a natural top scout.
Under Xia's precise guidance, the Lin Kuei drove the giant lizard and moved forward along a hidden path with twists and turns.
Sometimes she listened to the sound of the wind, sometimes she narrowed her bloody eyes and looked into the distance.
Potential threats can always be spotted dozens of breaths in advance.
They cleverly used terrain cover to perfectly avoid all demon activity areas.
The relatively wide field of vision in Odo Canyon allows Shia to fully utilize her long-sightedness.
Only half a day later, they arrived at their destination - Kalan City.
The huge city is cleverly nestled between the rolling hills.
The towering city walls glowed with a cold luster in the sunlight.
Like a dormant giant beast, it may wake up at any time.
Showing the adventurer nameplate, the guard roughly checked the conspicuous and stuffed envelope in the backpack without much obstruction.
Lin Gui followed the endless flow of people.
Passing through the majestic city wall, which is more than fifty meters high and made of huge black obsidian rocks.
Officially entered this real city-state.
As soon as they entered the city, Xia turned around first.
The coolness inside the city gate and the first warm sunshine cast in the city.
Intertwined on her body, outlining her slender figure.
She smiled at Lin Gui, and her blood-jade eyes looked particularly clear under the light.
"How does it feel when you come to Kalan City for the first time?"
After passing the last level, Lin Gui looked around, his eyes keenly scanning every detail.
Apart from being several times larger than the New Testament City, there doesn't seem to be many essential differences.
A wide main road paved with huge stone slabs.
Stretching straight towards the distant hill, is the lord's castle.
On both sides of the main road are countless narrow, bumpy, muddy paths.
It extends to every corner of the city like blood vessels.
The side of the trail is crowded with stone or wooden houses built haphazardly.
They were close together, looking dark and damp.
There was a mixed roar of various sounds in my ears.
Vendors shouted at the top of their lungs, and there was a loud rumble of wheels running over stone slabs.
The mercenary laughed and cursed rudely, and the Warcraft mount neighed impatiently.
And the never-ending tinkling sound of iron coming from the blacksmith shop in the distance...
All these sounds intertwine to form a chaotic urban symphony.
Numb-looking civilians were hunched over carrying heavy loads.
Make way for the patrolling guards with evasive eyes.
The travel-worn adventurer openly hugged the scantily clad Liu Ying with empty eyes.
Teasing without restraint.
